description: Assay provenance behind bioactivity rows, for one assay or a shortlist in one call: description, type (binding / functional / ADMET / toxicity), BioAssay Ontology format (single protein, cell-based, organism-based, …), the target it measures, organism, cell type, tissue, strain, source document, and ChEMBL's 0–9 confidence score (9 = direct single protein target, lower = homologous, complex, or non-protein targets, 0 = no target assigned yet). Supply assay_chembl_ids from chembl_get_bioactivities rows: the first 100 distinct IDs are looked up and returned in the order given, the rest come back in deferred_ids to pass again, and an ID with no assay record (a compound or target ID included) is listed in not_found_ids rather than failing the call. Call this to judge whether measurements are comparable before ranking them together.

assay_chembl_ids.description: ChEMBL assay IDs from bioactivity rows' assay_chembl_id, e.g. ["CHEMBL674637", "CHEMBL3877213"]: 1–1000, any case. The first 100 distinct IDs are looked up; the rest come back in deferred_ids.

name: chembl_get_assay

assays.description: The assays found, in the order their IDs were given.

items.description: One assay: its provenance and confidence score.

assay_cell_type.description: Cell line or cell type the assay ran in, e.g. "A-431". Null when ChEMBL records none, as for most assays that are not cell-based.

assay_strain.description: Strain of the organism the assay used, e.g. "Sprague-Dawley". Null when ChEMBL records none.

assay_tissue.description: Tissue the assay ran in, e.g. "Liver", "Plasma". Null when ChEMBL records none.

assay_type.description: Assay type code: B=binding, F=functional, A=ADMET, T=toxicity, P=physicochemical, U=unclassified. Null when absent.

assay_type_description.description: Human-readable assay type, e.g. "Binding". Null when absent.

bao_label.description: BioAssay Ontology format of the assay, e.g. "single protein format", "cell-based format", "organism-based format", "tissue-based format". Null when absent.

confidence_description.description: Human-readable confidence description, e.g. "Direct single protein target assigned". Null when absent.

confidence_score.description: ChEMBL confidence score, 0–9: 9 = direct single protein target, 8 = homologous single protein, 7–4 = protein complexes or multiple proteins, 3–1 = a non-protein, subcellular, or non-molecular target, 0 = no target assigned yet (ChEMBL's default; target_chembl_id is then a placeholder such as Unchecked or ADMET). Null when absent from the record.

description.description: Assay description text. Null when absent.

document_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL document ID of the publication or deposited dataset that described the assay, e.g. "CHEMBL3875233" — pass to chembl_get_documents for its title, PMID, and DOI to cite. Null when absent.

organism.description: Organism ChEMBL records for the assay itself, not its target's organism. Null when the assay records none, even when the target is a human protein.

target_chembl_id.description: ChEMBL target ID the assay measures — chain to chembl_search_targets/chembl_get_bioactivities. Null when unassigned.

deferred_ids.description: Distinct IDs past the first 100, not looked up, in the order given — pass them as assay_chembl_ids in another call. Empty when none.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: ChEMBL rate-limits the upstream request. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

not_found_ids.description: IDs looked up that ChEMBL holds no assay for — an unknown ID, or a compound, target, or document ID — in the order given. Empty when every ID looked up was found.

notice.description: Present when not_found_ids or deferred_ids is non-empty: counts each and says where assay IDs come from and how to look up the deferred ones.

title: chembl-get-assay
